static_traits.name: Zhang Yu
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide in, but the relationship is somewhat affected because I frequently express disappointment
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness, no prior counseling/therapy history
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, clear expression, relatively high cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to ignore the positive aspects of my day and focus on the negative, which makes me feel discouraged and disappointed easily. This thinking pattern has existed for a while but has become more prominent in recent months. The closure of the skate park triggers these feelings, and I have these negative thoughts almost daily, especially when plans have not gone as expected.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to find better ways to manage these negative thoughts so they do not keep ruining my every day. I hope to enjoy life and my hobbies again.

core_beliefs: Good things are not reliable; bad things are the real thing
Things are either perfect or a complete failure

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the plan is disrupted, the day equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Complains to friends; tries to distract attention with other activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today is ruined, my whole day is destroyed

special_situations.event: Something happening that day that does not go as planned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one thing does not go smoothly, it means the whole day (or even beyond) will be terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Dwells on that one bad thing and ignores other aspects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nothing will go smoothly anymore, why bother trying

special_situations.event: In one day, both positive and negative things exist at the same time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as one bad thing happens, none of the good counts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Filters out positive experiences and only repeatedly focuses on the negative
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those good things are meaningless; today is overall terrible

special_situations.event: Sharing the day's experiences with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When my mood is not good, other aspects are not worth noticing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly venting disappointment to friends, selectively focusing on unhappiness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Today is really bad; there is nothing good to say

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain control and pleasure in daily life, to be understood and supported by others
core_conflict.fear: Fear of uncertainty and disappointment, worrying that positive experiences are not reliable and could be shattered at any moment
defense_goal: Reducing disappointment through black-and-white thinking and negating-the-positive evaluation, maintaining a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: Easily defined by a single setback as 'a frustrated individual'
object_relations.object_representation: The environment/others are unreliable, disappointment-prone existences

manifestations: Feeling 'if something goes wrong once, there is no need to keep trying' (e.g., why bother, if this day will be bad anyway)
Enjoyment of daily activities decreased, interests (such as skateboarding) affected
Considering the whole day ruined when plans are disrupted
outcomes: Decreased drive and avoiding positive experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, the opposite of 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When encountering negative emotions, tends to use distraction to avoid directly experiencing the emotions
When interacting with friends, uses complaining/venting in place of direct awareness and expression of present emotions and needs

positive_force: Has friends to confide in (some social support)
Having preliminary awareness of my negative thought patterns and proactively seeking counseling
negative_force: Cognitive biases present: black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, mental filtering, and negating the positive
Highly sensitive to plans being frustrated, external events strongly determining mood
Coping dominated by distraction and complaining has difficulty relieving negative thinking and may maintain the problem
Self-efficacy and daily enjoyment decline, further weakening positive action

target_behavior.behavior: When plans are frustrated, catastrophizing/black-and-white self-statements appear (such as 'my day is ruined') accompanied by obvious frustration
antecedent: Anything that day that does not go as planned
target_behavior.core_reason: Holding a catastrophic Interpretation of setbacks, with cognitive biases including mental filtering, negating the positive, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: Avoiding direct contact with disappointment and seeking short-term relief/others' attention (through complaining and distracting attention)
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and Decreased drive; studies, relationships, and interests affected; negative thinking maintained and Reinforced
